scope: Administrative evidence timestamp provenance only; no scientific assessment
finding: The helper places filesystem modification time into accessed_at for a GitHub comment source. Filesystem modification time is not intrinsically a recorded HTTP retrieval time. The comment itself records publication/updated timestamps, which are also not retrieval time.
proposed_fix: Use an actual recorded retrieval receipt if available; otherwise omit accessed_at for this local administrative capture or explicitly qualify local filesystem capture metadata without presenting it as verified retrieval time.
reproduction: Read exact source expression and saved comment JSON; no input modified, no publication invoked.
limitations: No claim that the actual mtime differs numerically from retrieval time; finding concerns unjustified timestamp semantics.
